properties.name: Parcel A — north wood (segment 1 of 3)
properties.conf_text: Line traced by eye from OS 25-inch 1900 field 45 (about ±10 m). That this field is the Parcel A wood is the Williams-Buckler family’s reconstruction; the wood's title plan (later WA735527) is not held.

properties.name: Parcel A — farmhouse, yard and buildings (segment 2 of 3)
properties.os: OS 1900 field 70 · 1·334 ac (OS figure); OS 1941: field 36, ·792 ac
properties.conf_text: Traced by eye from the walls and buildings round the yard on OS 25-inch 1900 (about ±5 m). OS field 70 also takes in ground west of the yard wall, so the OS figure is larger than this outline. The registered boundary of WA240304 is not held.

properties.name: Parcel A — the green (lower third, VG41 area)
properties.os: VG41 (registered 16 Jun 1970); 1990 condition: at least 0.25 ac kept as green
properties.conf_text: Drawn as the lower third of Parcel A: from the south wall of the house and yard down to the triangle by the Cross and Pound on the OS 25-inch sheet of 1947, the ground the 1985 certified VG41 register map points to by Leckwith Road. Basis: Sion Buckler’s instruction of 21 Oct 2026 and the Legal Wiki’s Three Parts of Parcel A. The VG41 register map and boundary are not held.

properties.name: Parcel B — the fields east of the house
properties.conf_text: Traced by eye from the colouring on the 1939 tenancy plan (DBDT123/7), matched to OS 1900 field lines (about ±10 m). The 1939 plan is a tenancy plan, not a freehold title plan.
